scope: pre-real-UE source input boundary; no gameplay state or timing ownership

identity.epoch: nonzero uint64 host reset generation; stale values rejected; exhaustion fails closed

delivery.duplicates: same control or already-held semantic action does not dispatch twice
delivery.release: only releases matching action/control; never dispatches gameplay
delivery.overflow: reject without evicting held records or mutating state
delivery.world_cadence: explicit selected direction presses only; no movement synthesis by UI time

focus.reset: focus owner/host-generation change clears holds and repeat; new epoch fences old events
focus.no_usable_world: available R9 UI retains safe Menu/load recovery; never world commands

analog.neutral: release previous axis owner; no action

repeat.settings: Remaster.UI MenuRepeat; GameUserSettings outside Emerald save

lifecycle.resume: all suspension reasons clear; flush platform held state; require a new press
lifecycle.disconnect: reset all input conservatively; reconnect does not restore held state
lifecycle.teardown: unbind callbacks/mapping context and clear captures
lifecycle.deferred: actual UE compile, Android callbacks and device behavior require R18/runtime evidence

mapping.enhanced: optional per action; bind started/changed/released/canceled and suppress only equivalent native fallback; missing/invalid asset retains fallback

touch.coordinates: normalized half-open rectangles in usable viewport after safe insets; reject nonfinite/invalid extents
touch.capture: only press starts capture; moving outside captured control cancels, never retargets until a new press
touch.preferences: presentation layout/visibility/scale only, GameUserSettings; no Emerald persistent fields

acceptance: same normalized action trace produces same dispatch trace across sources
duplicate/multi-source holds do not multiply commands
stale/release/malformed/overflow events do not mutate gameplay
blocked/modal/dialogue/battle actions cannot fall through to world
lifecycle/focus reset clears holds/repeat/capture with epoch fencing
shared R9 menu repeat accepts touch/keyboard/gamepad/Enhanced hold and preserves 24/3 cadence
native compiled shared router plus R4/R9 regressions pass
source validators never certify real Unreal/device acceptance
